points.description: States that the statement is FALSE. This earns its mark only when given together with a correct justification (P2), since the question awards no marks without one.

Justifies the verdict by stating the pipe's direction: writing is done only on fd[1] and reading only from fd[0]. So data written to fd[0] cannot be read back on fd[0], and writing on fd[0] is not the intended use. Equivalent wording such as 'fd[1] is the write end, fd[0] is the read end' earns the marks.
points.partial_credit: 0.75 if the student states only one of the two ends correctly (e.g. reads from fd[0] but does not say writes go to fd[1], or the reverse).
